ui.welcome.title: The Vanished Classroom
ui.welcome.subtitle: Can you uncover the classroom practices that time left behind?
ui.welcome.body: Classrooms have changed enormously over the last two hundred years. Some practices that once seemed normal have disappeared from schools completely. Step inside the vanished classroom to investigate nine teaching relics from the 1800s and discover what eventually replaced them.
ui.directions.title: How to investigate each exhibit
ui.directions.body1: Visit each exhibit and study the image and clues. First, identify the classroom practice or tool. Next, decide what problem it was meant to solve. Finally, choose the practice or technology that eventually replaced it.
ui.directions.body2: You may revisit exhibits before submitting your final answers.
ui.directions.step1body: Use the clues and image area to decide what the practice or tool is.
ui.directions.step2body: Choose the problem this practice was meant to solve.
ui.directions.step3body: Select what classrooms use today in its place.
ui.list.title: Choose an exhibit to investigate
ui.list.body: Each desk opens a three-part investigation. Finished exhibits stay available for review.

ui.score.title: Your Vanished Classroom Result
ui.level.msg1: You tracked these classroom relics across time with expert-level accuracy.
ui.level.msg2: You uncovered strong evidence about how old practices shaped today's classrooms.
ui.level.msg3: You spotted many important clues and connected several relics to their replacements.

ui.ace.title: Think it through with ACE
ui.ace.intro: ACE moves you from spotting individual clues to explaining and testing a conclusion — Articulate, Connect, and Extend.
ui.ace.a.title: A — Articulate It
ui.ace.a.q: What do the clues tell you? Explain them in your own words.
ui.ace.c.title: C — Connect It
ui.ace.c.q: How do the clues connect to something you already know?
ui.ace.e.title: E — Extend It
ui.ace.e.q: Test your conclusion. What else should be true if your answer is correct?
ui.ace.card.title: Classroom-Ready ACE Card
ui.ace.card.aq: What do the clues say in your own words?
ui.ace.card.cq: How do the clues fit together?
ui.ace.card.eq: What prediction could prove or disprove your answer?
ui.ace.why.label: Why ACE works:
ui.ace.why.body: Students name what they notice, explain how the clues support a conclusion, and test whether that conclusion holds up.
